gaps.sentence: These wires must ___ by a qualified electrician.
gaps.explanation: After a modal, passive = be + past participle: must be checked. 'Been' needs 'have'.

gaps.sentence: By the time the reporters arrived, the evidence ___ (destroy).
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + past participle for the action completed before the arrival.

gaps.sentence: Every complaint ___ (investigate) since the new ombudsman took over.
gaps.explanation: 'Every complaint' is singular, so present perfect passive: has been + investigated.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (inspect) twice a year for signs of corrosion.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a year' marks a routine: present simple passive, is + inspected.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ while the family was on holiday.
gaps.explanation: Ongoing during the holiday: past continuous passive were being + opened.
The policy receives the action: 'will be introduced'.

gaps.sentence: Your booking ___ (confirm) by email — check your spam folder.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + confirmed; the confirmation exists now.

gaps.sentence: This bridge ___ repaired twice this year already.
gaps.explanation: 'Already' + present perfect passive: has been repaired.
